contacts.title: Contacts and customers
contacts.description: Everyone who contacts your business gets one profile with a number, name, conversation history, notes, and status.
points: WhatsApp conversations connect to the profile.
Internal notes stay hidden from customers.
Labels and segments help organize customers.
Search and filters make history easy to find.

leads.title: Leads

points: Create leads from a conversation or manually.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: See every lead across your sales stages, from the first question to the purchase.
points: Stages can match the way you sell.
Every stage change is recorded.
Leads that pile up in a stage are visible.
Stale leads are easy to find.

followUp.title: Follow-ups
followUp.description: Schedule follow-ups for customers who have not decided yet, at the time you choose.
points: Schedule a follow-up directly from a conversation.
Reminders appear for the staff member who needs to act.

followUp.audience: Most useful for: sales and customer service.

tasks.title: Activities and tasks
tasks.description: Record what needs to be done, by whom, and when.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

reports.title: Reports

roles.title: Roles and access
roles.description: Every team member has a role with different access rights.

inbox.title: WhatsApp inbox and AI replies
inbox.description: Conversations from your business number enter one inbox. AI handles routine questions and staff take over when needed.

audit.title: Data and audit
audit.description: Sigap's foundation keeps business data separate and important changes traceable.

one.question: What is Sigap?
one.answer: Sigap is a platform for managing business WhatsApp conversations, customers, leads, and follow-ups in one place.

two.question: Do I have to change my WhatsApp number?
two.answer: No. You connect the business WhatsApp number you already use, according to the connection method available for your account.

three.question: What does the AI do?
three.answer: AI helps answer routine questions from the business information you provide. Staff can take over at any time.

four.question: What if the AI gives a wrong answer?
four.answer: Staff can see the conversation and take over. Business information and handoff rules can also be updated.

five.question: Does Sigap replace customer service?
five.answer: No. Sigap reduces routine work, while cases that need judgment and empathy remain with people.

six.question: Is each business's data separated?
six.answer: Yes. Sigap is designed with separate data spaces and role-based team access.

seven.question: Is pricing available yet?
seven.answer: Yes. Starter starts at Rp299,000 per month, Business at Rp799,000 per month, and Self-host from Rp2,500,000 per month. WhatsApp and third-party AI fees may be billed separately based on usage.
